title: Grandmaster Rewards: the Sword-Master and the Arch-Magister

sections.heading: Teaching at 100
items: Blade (at 100): take up to two sword apprentices. Stand beside someone and type /swordschool take followed by their name; they accept with /swordschool accept. When your apprentice duels you, their sword blows on you teach them Blade half again as fast. Their daily limits still apply. /swordschool release or /swordschool leave ends it.
Arcane Arts (at 100): you may keep one more magic apprentice than your rank allows, and your apprentices learn their spell in half the time.
